summary: API supporting NextAuth authentication, Telegram bot integration for user registration and report creation/retrieval, and static file serving.

notes: Handles NextAuth GET endpoints: session, csrf, providers, signin, signout, callback.
Handles NextAuth POST endpoints: callback/credentials (login), signout. Expects identifier and password.
Request body is documented in OpenAPI
Requires reportId query parameter to fetch messages for a specific report.
Check whether a Telegram chat is linked to a registered user
Checks if a Telegram chat is linked to a registered user. Requires chatId.
Request body is documented in OpenAPI
Link a Telegram account to a Participium user via auth token
Links Telegram account to Participium user. Requires authToken and chatId.
Request body is documented in OpenAPI

dependencies: POST /api/telegram/registration: Listing reports requires the chat to be registered.
notes: Get reports for a Telegram user
Fetches reports for a Telegram user. Requires chatId query parameter.

dependencies: POST /api/telegram/registration: Creating a report requires the chat to be registered.
notes: Create a report via the Telegram bot
Creates a report via Telegram bot. Requires title, description, latitude, longitude, category, chatId.
Request body is documented in OpenAPI

dependencies: POST /api/telegram/registration: Report retrieval requires the chat to be registered and linked to a user.
notes: Get a single report for a Telegram user
Fetches a single report. Requires id (path) and chatId (query).
Serves an uploaded image file. Requires filename (path).

authentication_notes: NextAuth endpoints at /api/auth/{nextauth} handle session management and login callbacks but do not enforce auth_required in the schema.
Telegram report creation (/api/telegram/reports POST) returns 401, implying authentication may be enforced at runtime despite auth_required being null.
dependencies: User must register Telegram account via /api/telegram/registration before fetching or creating reports for that chat.
Report creation (/api/telegram/reports POST) likely depends on prior registration to establish chatId linkage.
POST /api/telegram/registration -> GET /api/telegram/reports/{id}: Report retrieval requires the chat to be registered and linked to a user.
POST /api/telegram/registration -> GET /api/telegram/reports: Listing reports requires the chat to be registered.
POST /api/telegram/registration -> POST /api/telegram/reports: Creating a report requires the chat to be registered.

dependency_edges.reason: Report retrieval requires the chat to be registered and linked to a user.
Listing reports requires the chat to be registered.
Creating a report requires the chat to be registered.

risks: auth_required is null for all operations, but 401 responses exist on some endpoints (e.g., /api/telegram/reports POST), creating ambiguity about when authentication is actually enforced.
/api/messages GET requires reportId but does not specify if the user must own or be associated with that report.
